hero_deck: Lima's airport had never charged international transfer passengers a fee. I designed the web channel to collect it, one of four ways to pay, and handed it over.
hero_role1: Roles — Internal consultant · UX/UI designer · Planning coordinator
hero_role3: Scope — Planning → UX/UI design → prototyping → evaluation → handoff
cta_live: Abrir la plataforma TUUA en vivo
hero_rv_txt: A passenger lands in Lima and connects to another international flight. At the new terminal they owe a fee the airport had never charged, and no channel existed to collect it. Five areas each held a piece of the problem. As the internal consultant from Processes and Innovation, I coordinated the planning between them, designed the web payment flow, evaluated it and handed it to the team that built it. TUUA Transfer runs today, charging 130,000+ international transfer passengers a month.
act0_verdict: A new fee, with no precedent to copy.
act0_lede: Three terms and three facts before the story starts.
act0_rv1: Jorge Chávez. Lima's international airport, run by the private operator Lima Airport Partners, where I worked.
act0_rv2: International transfer passenger. A passenger who arrives in Lima on an international flight and connects to another international flight.
act0_rv3: TUUA. Tarifa Unificada de Uso de Aeropuerto, the airport-use fee. TUUA Transfer is the one charged for the services these passengers use while they board.
act0_c1_x: Nobody had charged it before. There was no internal or external precedent to follow.
act0_c2_x: Today the fee is charged to 130,000+ international transfer passengers a month, on a platform a third party operates.
act0_c3_x: Three staffed payment points and one web platform. The web is the only digital channel, and the one whose flow I designed.
act1_verdict: A fee with no way to collect it.
act1_lede: Why engineering was waiting on a definition.
act1_scan1: The airport had to start charging international transfer passengers a fee it had never charged, and no channel existed to collect it.
act1_scan2: Five areas each held a piece of it: Finance, Airport Operations, IT, Commercial and Reputation.
act1_scan3: Engineering was waiting on a definition.
act2_verdict: Five areas at the table. I coordinated, I did not own.
act2_lede: Where I sat between the areas that shaped the fee.
act2_c1_x: Finance, Airport Operations, IT, Commercial and Reputation each held a piece of the fee.
act2_c2_x: I was the internal consultant from Processes and Innovation. I coordinated the planning across the five areas, delivered the design work and advised in the decision meetings.
act2_c3_t: Lo que dice de mí el acta
act2_c3_x: The client sat in another internal area, and the programme charter's stakeholder table does not list me as owner. That is the accurate record and this page keeps it.
act2_synth: The planning I coordinated held across all five areas through launch.
act3_lede: The scope my area delivered, in the closure mail's own list.
act3_c1_x: One for the platform and one for the payment gateway: the structural requirements handed to engineering.
act3_c2_x: The proposed payment screens, and a web prototype of the flow.
act3_c3_x: An operational casuistry estimating web-payment usage, and a process map: a blueprint for the physical payment points and a flowchart for the web one.
act3_synth: The closure mail listed all five on 4 August 2025: scope defined, deliverables handed over, work package closed.
act4_verdict: Four screens, from sign-up to ticket.
act4_lede: The payment flow I designed, as I proposed it.
act4_s1_alt: Pantalla 1 redibujada, Datos personales: campos de nombre y correo y un botón Registrar.
act4_s2_alt: Pantalla 2 redibujada, Validación de código: cuatro casillas para el código enviado por correo, con Validar, Reenviar código y Cambiar correo.
act4_m2_x: Ingrese el código enviado al correo que registró.
act4_s2_cap: 2 · Validación. Un código enviado a ese correo.
act4_s3_alt: Pantalla 3 redibujada, Método de pago: tipo de tarjeta, campos de número y CVV y un botón Pagar.
act4_s3_cap: 3 · Pasarela de pago. Datos de la tarjeta.
act4_s4_alt: Pantalla 4 redibujada, Detalle de ticket: un número de ticket, un código QR para escanear en el eGate y un botón Descargar comprobante.
act4_m4_scan: Escanee el QR en el eGate.
act4_m4_sent: Se envió el comprobante y el QR a su correo.
act4_s4_cap: 4 · Confirmación de pago. Un código QR para el eGate, enviado también por correo.
act4_flow_alt: Flowchart of the passenger's interactions with the TUUA Transfer payment platform, from scanning the platform QR code, through the four screens, to the TUUA turnstile and boarding.
act4_flow_cap: The flowchart. From the QR code that opens the platform, through the four screens, to the TUUA turnstile and boarding. Names, email and card numbers on the mockup are dummy data.
act4_rv_txt: The web platform is one of four ways to pay the fee, and the only digital one. On the web, the passenger receives a QR code by email and shows it at the eGate. At the three staffed channels, the passenger receives a bar-code sticker on the boarding pass instead.
act5_verdict: My part ended where the build began.
act5_lede: How the proposal was evaluated, and where it stopped.
act5_c1_x: Sesiones de revisión con stakeholders para la plataforma digital, y observación de campo en los módulos de pago físicos, evidenciadas por dos encuestas previas a la prueba y un conjunto de notas cualitativas. Son métodos distintos que responden preguntas distintas, y ninguno reemplaza al otro.
act5_c2_x: El mismo correo de cierre indica que el desarrollo añadiría una a dos pantallas además de las que propuse, con ajustes menores, sujeto a la aprobación de la versión final por Facturación. La línea entre mi entregable y el del proveedor está escrita en los propios documentos del programa, no solo en mi relato.
act5_c3_x: Setting the fee was never my decision, and neither were the platform's build, deployment or operation. A third party operates it today.
act6_verdict: La plataforma está en vivo, no es mía, y la diferencia entre lo que propuse y lo que se publicó es pública.
act6_lede: A year later, I reviewed the live platform against my own proposal.
act6_method: Solo páginas públicas, sin autenticación. No se envió ninguna transacción, no se capturó ninguna sesión y no se recogieron datos más allá de lo que cualquier visitante ve.
act6_f1_txt: Personal data first: name and email, a validation code, then payment and the ticket.
act6_f2_txt: The flight first: an eligibility self-declaration, flight details with the fee, then customer details before the payment control.
act6_bridge: Reordered, not removed. Personal-data capture now follows the flight lookup, and I measured it doing exactly that on the customer-details screen. I read the reordering as intuitive and do not contest it.
act6_scan1: Hay cuatro pantallas accesibles antes del propio control de pago: la página de inicio, una autodeclaración de elegibilidad, una pantalla de datos del vuelo con la tarifa y una pantalla de datos del cliente. El recorrido se detiene ahí, a propósito, a un control de pagar.
act6_scan2: The fee is set at $11.86, shown a full screen earlier than I proposed and consistent between its two appearances: $23.72 for two passengers. Fee-setting was never my decision.
act6_scan3: La elegibilidad depende de un clic de autodeclaración ("Soy ese tipo de pasajero") y no de la verificación automática de acuerdos que especificaba el alcance técnico. Hasta donde conozco el build, esa verificación nunca se implementó como estaba escrita. Este recorrido no pudo ver más allá de su propio límite para confirmarlo.
act6_findings: Seis hallazgos: uno mayor, cinco menores, ninguno crítico. El mayor es una pantalla titulada "Ingresa tus datos personales y de tu vuelo" cuyos únicos campos son datos del vuelo.
act6_synth: Puedo leer en público la brecha entre la propuesta y el build, que es una mejor posición que tener que describirla.
act6_sequel: What I can claim: the design, prototype, evaluation and handoff of a platform live today. What I can't: its build, deployment or operation. What's next: six findings, one of them major, recorded for whoever runs it.
act3_notice: TUUA Transfer. Entiendo el mecanismo de la plataforma y contribuí a su diseño UX/UI, no a su desarrollo, despliegue u operación.
